Studio repro (isolated, r1.localhost, sys_user.locale zh-CN):
 1. New object in a writable package.
 2. Add any field; the autosave PUT fields.queue.label is 队列.
 3. Publish, then 全部发布: POST publish-drafts 200, outcome published, success toast.
 4. Records tab: load-error state. GET /data/OBJ 404 'Object is not registered' OBJECT_NOT_FOUND; GET /meta/object/OBJ 200.

 - GET /meta/object/<any published object> with Accept-Language: zh-CN
 - PUT /meta/object/NEW?mode=draft&package=PKG with those fields, minus __search

Reproduced 3 times in Studio (twice not isolated, once isolated) and by API. Automation self-check: the server log and bearer API reads agree; traps ruled out. Not found in a read-only issue search.
Related: other injected columns are also stored with translated labels but do not throw.

F2 - Low, off-clause, needs a ruling. GET /meta/dashboard/NAME?package=NONHOLDER answers 200 with another package's row (_packageId com.qa.pkgb), also for a package whose own row was just deleted. Repro: rows in A and B, DELETE ?package=A, GET ?package=A. May be a deliberate fallback; a reader asking for A's row cannot tell it got B's.

F3 - Low UX, off-clause. Opening Repair Center (no currency field on the object) raised a 'Set the default currency' modal over the end-user list. Seen once.

F4 - Note, environment-triggered. packages-io.ts calls are cookie-only (credentials: include). With a dead cookie and a live bearer, Studio shows the failed chip, loses the namespace, and the New object dialog previews and writes an unprefixed name with no warning (rep_two, in zh-CN). Only seen under the cookie collision; a real analogue would be an expired cookie with a live bearer token.

PROBE LINE
About 10 minutes, admin persona only. Covered: empty ?package=, non-holder ?package=, rollback bad values and an unknown version, If-None-Match:* on an absent name, sealed draft/?package= variants, a package with no rows on revert, extra types on the uninstalled door, restart recovery for F1. Found F1's durability and F2.

CHECKLIST ACCURACY

- api-written-keys object variant: titleFormat stale since 3557366c02.
- multi-package acceptance[3]: 'every write over a sealed name' overstates; flow and field differ.
- first-run-loop: no locale is named, and steps[1] uses a Chinese display name. Suggest a named zh-CN leg, since en passes and zh-CN does not.
